pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.2: tena kho pana samayena caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī saṃsaṭṭhā viharati gahapatināpi gahapatiputtenāpi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā caṇḍakāḷī saṃsaṭṭhā viharissati gahapatināpi gahapatiputtenapī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī saṃsaṭṭhā viharati gahapatināpi gahapatiputtenāpīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, caṇḍakāḷī bhikkhunī saṃsaṭṭhā viharissati gahapatināpi gahapatiputtenāpi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.11.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī saṃsaṭṭhā vihareyya gahapatinā vā gahapatiputtena vā sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi evamassa vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.12: “māyye saṃsaṭṭhā vihari gahapatināpi gahapatiputtenāpi. viviccayye vivekaññeva bhaginiyā saṅgho vaṇṇetī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.13: evañca sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi vuccamānā tatheva paggaṇheyya sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbā tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:1.14: yāvatatiyañce samanubhāsiyamānā taṃ paṭinissajjeyya iccetaṃ kusalaṃ. no ce paṭinissajjeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.14: aññāhi bhikkhunīhi. yā passanti yā suṇanti tāhi vattabbā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.35: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī saṃsaṭṭhā viharati gahapatināpi gahapatiputtenapi,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.37: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ manubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.40: ayaṃ itthannāmā bhikkhunī saṃsaṭṭhā viharati gahapatināpi gahapatiputtenāpi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.42: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuniṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.43: yassā ayyāya khamati itthannāmāya bhikkhuniyā samanubhāsanā tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya. sā tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.47: samanubhaṭṭhā saṅghena itthannāmā bhikkhunī tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc36:2.1.48: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
